name: What type of tile works best for custom shower walls and floors?

mainEntity.name: What type of tile works best for custom shower walls and floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic tile are popular choices for shower walls because they are dense, non-porous, and simple to clean. For shower floors, smaller tiles—such as mosaics, penny rounds, or textured porcelain—are preferred because the increased grout joints provide natural slip resistance on a wet, sloped surface. Natural stone like marble, slate, or travertine offers high-end beauty, but it requires regular sealing and careful maintenance with pH-neutral cleaners to prevent staining and water absorption. Choosing larger tiles for walls reduces grout lines, while smaller tiles on the floor ensure safety and follow pan contours cleanly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain and ceramic tile work best for walls due to low maintenance, while smaller mosaic tiles are ideal for shower floors to provide slip resistance on sloped pans.
